P02.Title: Account access
P02.Help: Sign-in, registration and profile information are not available on Windows yet. Local writing assistance works without signing in.
P07.Title: Use Windows Hello
P07.Help: Local unlocking with a PIN or biometrics will be available once secure session protection is ready. No credentials are stored here.
G01.Title: Interface language
G01.Help: Choose Follow Windows, Danish or English for settings. The writing language and language pack do not change.
G02.Title: Writing language
G02.Help: Selects the same active language as the toolbar. Suggestions require an installed, compatible language pack.
G03.Title: Allow Follow caret in supported apps and text fields
G03.Help: Allows the placement choice in the suggestions window. Turning this off selects static placement and stops caret measurements. Turning it on does not select Follow caret; an uncertain position always uses static placement.
G04.Title: Installed version
G04.Help: The version of the running Windows app. Installed MSIX editions also show the package version.
G05.Title: Automatically check for updates
G05.Help: Windows App Installer manages automatic updates. The app cannot safely change this OS setting yet.
G06.Title: Check now…
G06.Help: Checks Windows beta update information. An installed official beta is required to open an update in Windows.
SpeechLanguage.Title: Read-aloud language
SpeechLanguage.Help: Automatic language selection currently also uses the writing language on Windows.
SystemSpeech.Title: Use system read-aloud settings
SystemSpeech.Help: Retains the Windows beta system choice. Turn it off to choose a voice and speed.
O01.Title: Voice
O01.Help: Selects an installed Windows voice for the writing language. The choice is saved separately for each language.
O02.Title: System read-aloud settings
O02.Help: Opens Windows speech settings. Additional voices are managed in Windows language settings.
O03.Title: Reading speed
O03.Help: Choose 50–150% in 5% steps. 100% is the voice default speed. Changing it selects app tempo instead of the previous Windows system preference.
O04.Title: Reading strategy
O04.Help: Read words at a word boundary, sentences at a full stop followed by a space, or paragraphs at a full stop followed by a newline. Pasted text blocks are not read automatically.
O05.Title: Highlight while reading
O05.Help: Choose no highlight, words or sentences during editor speech. Highlights follow native voice timing. Editing, focus changes and Stop cancel safely.
F01.Title: Enable suggestions
F01.Help: Turns global Windows beta suggestions on or off. The separate editor retains its own documents.
F17.Title: Domain word lists
F17.Help: Specialised suggestion lists are not available on Windows yet. The saved preference is retained.
T01.Title: Enable text analysis
T01.Help: This feature is not available on Windows yet. Your saved settings are retained.
T02.Title: POS colouring
T02.Help: This feature is not available on Windows yet. Your saved settings are retained.
T03.Title: Semantic context diagnostics (beta)
T03.Help: This feature is not available on Windows yet. Your saved settings are retained.
T04.Title: Punctuation diagnostics (beta)
T04.Help: This feature is not available on Windows yet. Your saved settings are retained.
L03.Title: Saved word choices
L03.Help: Saved interpretation choices are separate from user words. They do not automatically change suggestions and do not imply sharing.
E01.Title: Enable error tracking
E01.Help: Records local kinds and counts for error insights. This is not permission to share text or enable all debug logs.
E02.Title: Save sentence examples locally
E02.Help: Text examples require a separate explicit choice. The control is not available yet; the saved preference is unchanged.
A01.Title: Performance instrumentation
A01.Help: Extended diagnostics are not available as a user setting yet. Raw text and credentials must not be stored in ordinary logs.
A02.Title: Debug logs: App
A02.Help: Extended diagnostics are not available as a user setting yet. Raw text and credentials must not be stored in ordinary logs.
A03.Title: Debug logs: Panel/UI Automation
A03.Help: Extended diagnostics are not available as a user setting yet. Raw text and credentials must not be stored in ordinary logs.
A05.Title: Debug logs: WordSuggestorCore
A05.Help: Extended diagnostics are not available as a user setting yet. Raw text and credentials must not be stored in ordinary logs.
A08.Title: Legacy settings
A08.Help: Opens the previous Windows settings. Only changed fields are saved, and concurrent changes are protected.
Window.Title: WordSuggestor Settings
AutoSaveNote: Changes are saved automatically on this PC.
AccountNote: Account, profile and local unlocking are not available in the Windows beta yet. Local documents and suggestions do not require sign-in.
SuggestionsNote: More suggestion, shortcut and domain-list settings will be added with their features. Existing shortcuts are unchanged.
AnalysisNote: Text analysis is not available yet. Your previous settings are retained.
LearningNote: Local storage and display of interpretation choices are not available on Windows yet. No sharing consent is created here. User words are still managed from the toolbar.
Legacy.LocalNote: Settings are saved locally in the Windows user profile.
Legacy.Title: Settings
Legacy.Subtitle: Customise suggestions, reading and local data.
Legacy.Voice: System voice for the active language
Legacy.NeuralNote: Importing additional neural voices is not supported on Windows yet.
Legacy.DomainsNote: Domain word lists are not available in this Windows beta yet.
Legacy.AnalysisNote: Text analysis is not available in this beta yet. Your settings are retained.
Legacy.ErrorNote: Error insights are stored locally as kinds and counts. Text examples require your explicit opt-in.
Legacy.DebugNote: Extended diagnostics settings are not available in this beta.
Legacy.UpdateNote: Windows automatically checks for updates when the beta is installed through App Installer. Updates preserve local settings, user words and language packs.
Legacy.ExternalNote: External insertion in this beta is qualified for Notepad. Use WordSuggestor’s separate editor in other apps or elevated windows.
Legacy.ShortcutNote: Shortcuts: Ctrl+1–0 selects suggestions. Ctrl+Left/Right changes page. Tab accepts in the editor. Ctrl+Alt+T reads selected text. Shortcuts are fixed in this beta.
VoiceAvailable: An installed Windows voice is available for {0}.
VoiceMissing: No installed Windows voice matches {0}. Install a voice in Windows; otherwise a fallback voice is used.
VoiceRuntimeUnavailable: A OneCore voice for {0} is installed, but playback is unavailable here. The system fallback can be used.
SaveFailed: The change could not be saved and was not applied. Existing data is preserved.
SaveConflict: Settings changed in another window. Close and reopen previous settings to load the latest values.
UnavailableData: Settings cannot be read safely. The file is preserved and changes cannot be saved. See troubleshooting in the Windows documentation.
MissingPackError: Selecting that language requires an installed, compatible language pack.
FollowDisabled: Follow caret is not permitted. The panel uses static placement.
FollowSelected: Follow caret is selected. An uncertain caret position uses static placement.
UpdateInstalled: Windows App Installer manages automatic updates. You can also check manually.
UpdateDevelopment: This edition is not installed as the official MSIX beta.
UpdateOpenFailed: Windows could not open the installer. Try again later.
Update.not_installed: Automatic updates require the installed Windows beta. Local test editions use their separate test feed.
Update.unpublished: A Windows beta feed has not been published yet.
Update.unavailable: Updates could not be checked. Try again later.
Update.invalid_feed: Update information could not be validated.
Update.offline: No connection to the update server. You can continue writing offline.
Update.available: Version {0} is ready. Save your work and exit WordSuggestor before installing the update.
Update.current: You have the latest published Windows beta.
SystemSpeechOverrideNotice: The previous system preference is active. Changing voice or speed selects app settings; system control remains available in legacy settings.
